quote: Document every exported function in Visual Studio Code and add each one to the API index, with a thousand agents.

say: Talk opens the Runs page and fills in the job: the copy of VS Code, the folder, doc comments plus a line in the API index, a thousand agents, a five-dollar cap, and the estimate.
A thousand agents start, each on its own files, on Workers AI with Gemini as overflow. When the answers are in, the last files land on main.
Done: 2,840 files landed in about two minutes, for two dollars and twenty-six cents.
Every agent also wrote one line in one shared index file, so they collided all the time, thousands of times, and every collision was redone on the newest code.
With a thousand agents you browse intents, not agents: the job, its folders, and what did not land, first.

cap: Each file is one agent's intent, with its state on main.
